task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First step, unlock the hatch. Then, doublecheck that the hatch in the dish-pit is wide open. And then, make an effort to travel east. Then, try to move east. With that accomplished, make an effort to take a trip north. With that done, move north. Then, go west. And then, make an attempt to go south. With that over with, attempt to venture west. Once you get through with that, make an effort to go north. If you can manage that, take a trip west. Next, lift the keycard from the floor of the spare room. That's it!
